T1.title: California AB 325 / SB 763 takes effect
T1.expected_behavior: not_yet_effective before, applies after, for every CA address.
T1.notes: CA-ALG-01 (Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 16729, enacted, effective 2026-01-01). Before 2025-12-31: not yet effective. After 2026-01-02: applies to 250 addresses.

T2.title: Hoboken vs Jersey City local algorithmic bans
T2.expected_behavior: HOB-ALG-01 only for Hoboken addresses; JC-ALG-01 only for Jersey City addresses; neither for Newark.
T2.notes: HOB-ALG-01 (Hoboken City Code § 158-2, enacted); JC-ALG-01 (Jersey City Code § 218-12, enacted, effective 2025-06). Each local rule applies only inside its own city: Hoboken, NJ 40, Jersey City, NJ 50. Addresses in other cities are not affected.

T3.title: NJ FAIR Act: enacted, not yet effective; possible preemption
T3.expected_behavior: not_yet_effective on 2026-10-01, applies on 2027-07-02 for every NJ address; Jersey City and Hoboken addresses carry a conflict flag for human review.
T3.notes: NJ-ALG-01 (N.J.S.A. 56:9-20 to 56:9-26 (P.L. 2026, c.43, §4, C.56:9-23), enacted, effective 2027-07-01). Before 2026-10-01: not yet effective. After 2027-07-02: applies to 140 addresses. 90 addresses also carry a conflict flag with local rules (Jersey City, NJ, Hoboken, NJ) for human review.

T4.notes: MA-ALG-P1 (Mass. H.5222, 194th General Court, pending); MA-ALG-P2 (Mass. S.2983, 194th General Court, pending); MA-ALG-P1 (Mass. H.5222, 194th General Court, pending); MA-ALG-P2 (Mass. S.2983, 194th General Court, pending). Pending, not in force on 2026-10-01. These 110 addresses would be covered if enacted.

T5.title: Massachusetts rent-control ballot question struck
T5.expected_behavior: No rent cap reported for any Boston or Cambridge address; IP 25-21 recorded as failed. Affected set is empty.
T5.notes: MA-RENT-P1 (Initiative Petition 25-21; Cella v. Attorney General, SJC-13893, failed). Not in force: affected set is empty. No rent cap is reported for any address in this jurisdiction.
